summary: Frontend-only e2e testing of POS redesign, category image upload, and CSV-imported customers. All requested flows PASS via Playwright as Owner (social.surya@gmail.com). POS grid shows 49 category tiles (data-testid pos-cat-tile-*), 0 direct product tiles by default. Variant dialog opens on tile click, lists variants with stripped prefix, and multi-variant add works. Selesai closes dialog and document.body.style.pointerEvents is '' (no lock). Multi-category cart (4 items across 3 categories) totalled Rp205.350; Bayar -> Tunai -> Konfirmasi produced receipt INV-260803-0019 successfully. Search 'APRON' switches grid to pos-product-* cards (4 matches). /pelanggan loaded 648 customer rows and contains 'GITA'. /kategori edit dialog accepts image upload (data-testid category-image-input), compresses & previews, and Simpan persists.

issues: Category tiles without an image show only a single fallback letter (e.g. all 'B'-starting categories look identical at a glance: 'B'). Consider showing a 2-letter monogram or the full name centered.

Accessibility console warnings: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' on most DialogContent, and 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' error on the receipt dialog (no DialogHeader/DialogTitle inside receipt-dialog). Add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle/Description to silence a11y errors.

action_items: Add DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden if needed) to the receipt-dialog in POS.jsx to fix Radix a11y error.
Consider adding DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Dialogs to silence a11y warnings.
Optional UX: render short category abbreviation instead of single first letter on unphotographed tiles.
critical_code_review_comments: POS.jsx line 488: onOpenChange for variantCat resets document.body.style.pointerEvents in setTimeout — good. Same guard is NOT applied to payOpen/depositOpen dialogs; if Radix ever leaves pointer-events:none from a fast-close of these, UI could freeze. Consider a shared cleanup pattern.
POS.jsx receipt-dialog has no DialogHeader/DialogTitle -> Radix logs an accessibility error each open.
catTiles keeps the whole product list embedded in each tile; fine at 300 products but should paginate/virtualize if catalog grows beyond a few thousand.
stripVariant only strips exact 'CategoryName - ' prefix and is case-sensitive; products named 'Apron - Drill SS' with cat 'APRON' would not be stripped.
seed_data_creation: One live sale INV-260803-0019 created (Rp185.000 subtotal, 4 items across APRON/Art Paper/BANNER) and stock decremented. One category was updated with an 8x8 test PNG image via Categories.jsx upload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: POS redesign verified. 49 categories, 300 products confirmed. Variant dialog + payment + receipt flow all clean, no pointer-events lock observed. Customers CSV shows 648 rows including GITA. Category image upload+persist works. Remaining minor items are all a11y warnings (missing DialogTitle/Description) — non-blocking.
